reason: The README describes a shared persistent memory and knowledge-lifecycle system for multiple agents, using an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault and local SQLite FTS5 search; its deployment workflow can also modify agent configuration files and schedule maintenance tasks.

summaries.zh: 为多个智能体提供基于本地 Markdown 知识库和 SQLite 全文索引的共享持久化记忆、检索与生命周期管理。
summaries.en: Provides shared persistent memory, search, and knowledge-lifecycle management for multiple agents through a local Markdown vault and SQLite full-text index.

capabilities: Persist agent knowledge in local Markdown vault files
Build and query a local SQLite FTS5 index
Submit, review, promote, adjudicate, and archive memory entries
Write or update agent configuration and instruction files during deployment
Run setup, self-check, and scheduled lifecycle tasks
